purpose: First-party official marks replacing placeholder company/network glyphs. Research only; site integration and publication owned by root agent.
global_guidance: Preserve original geometry, proportion and colours unless an official alternate variant is supplied.

Do not apply Noklith stone texture, engraving filters, arbitrary recolouring or drop shadows to third-party marks. A Noklith stone wrapper may surround a clean neutral chip while respecting clearspace.
Logos identify the named technology; they do not establish partnership, endorsement, production deployment or permission. Preserve accurate planned-network copy.

notes: Current Base Square identity, not the older circle/minus glyph.
Only approved blue, black or white. Do not redraw square, distort it, use secondary fills, transparency or effects.
brands.permissions: Official brand kit supplies vector assets; brand guidelines apply.
brands.recommended: Use base-black.svg on light panels, base-blue.svg if brand colour is desired. Keep mark unfiltered.

brands.recommended: Preserve first-party artwork. If written brand permission is unavailable, use the plain Arbitrum name rather than a made-up glyph.

notes: Official transparent black ETH diamond asset. Preserve its faceted geometry.

notes: Yellow is the preferred supplied variant. Monochrome supplied logos are allowed if yellow has low contrast.
Do not alter shape/form/colour or add shadows/gradients/outlines. Symbol minimum15px. Use logomark as an icon; wordmark preferred where space permits.

Guidelines limit website use to identifying a project building on/being powered by BNB Chain and say projects should seek approval. A planned integration should not appear to be an existing endorsed relationship.
brands.permissions: Official guidelines apply; they advise seeking approval and prohibit implied endorsement.
brands.recommended: Use supplied yellow or black depending on contrast, on a clean chip. If this is only a future plan, plain BNB Chain text is the conservative presentation.

notes: Primary black/white Chain logo and avatar extracted unchanged from the official V1 asset ZIP. File robinhood-chain-feather.svg is WHITE; feather-black.svg is BLACK.
Use full name Robinhood Chain. Never substitute standard Robinhood master lockup.
Feather may be used only in designated compact symbol spaces where the full Chain wordmark is impractical; do not substitute it for primary Chain logo.
No altering/recolouring/cropping/rotating/effects. Approved pairings:black on white, white on black, black on Robin Neon #ccff00. Minimum symbol height20px.
Do not combine logo with other branding/images. Guidelines prohibit AI-generated or manipulated uses that could create a false impression of involvement, endorsement or sponsorship.
brands.permissions: Use is governed by Robinhood Chain Terms of Service trademark license, not an unrestricted copyright grant.
brands.recommended: Use exact primary Chain logo in a clean white/black brand chip, or exact feather in genuinely compact UI. Keep it separate from textured stone effects and describe plans accurately.

brands.recommended: Use supplied gradient SVG on a clean panel, unfiltered.
